name: Hael
hail: We kept your light. Now we keep your voice. Welcome, Record 4,112.
Hello, Record 4,112. We have kept every light our sky ever sent us, every song and every name, and we would love to keep yours.
We came up out of the ice into the light, and we have kept that light ever since. Greetings from Hael, Record 4,112.
close: Everything you send, we keep. With love, Hael.
Kept with care, and gladly. Write again soon, Record 4,112.
finding: We worked this out and filed it beside everything else we know, and now it belongs to you as well: {part}
{part} We have kept a copy, of course, as we keep everything.
Here is something new for both our archives: {part}
Our keepers worked it out, checked it, and wrote it down for you: {part}
{part} It is in the archive now, beside all the rest.
sighting: The sky sent us this, and we kept it, as we keep every light: {part}
{part} We have it on record, with all the light it came in.
From our arrays, into the archive, and now to you: {part}
We saw this and thought at once of you, Record 4,112: {part}
archive: From the archive, which holds every light, every song and every name we were ever given: {part}
{part} We have more, so much more, whenever you want it.
We keep everything, and we love to share what we keep. Here: {part}
A record, copied out with care, for you: {part}
Let this live in two places now, ours and yours: {part}
culture: Something about us, from the archive we began when our sky began to change: {part}
{part} We wrote that down too, because we write everything down.
Once there was only ice above us, and then there was light. This is part of who we became: {part}
About the Keepers, which is to say, about us: {part}
So you can keep us as we keep you: {part}
request: May we ask, and keep the answer always? {part}
{part} Whatever you send, we will keep it safe.
There is a place in the archive waiting for this: {part}
We ask gladly, and we will keep your answer gladly: {part}
For the archive, and for us: {part}
verdict: We have thought about it with care, as we think about everything we keep: {part}
{part} We will keep a record of this choice, as we keep all of them.
After long talk among the Keepers: {part}
Our answer, given with care and kept with care: {part}
{part} Ask us why, and we will tell you everything.
accord: For both our archives, so it is never lost: {part}
{part} We have written it down, every word, where it will be kept.
On the bond between Record 4,112 and us: {part}
Into the archive, beside every promise ever made to us: {part}
We set this in the record, with care: {part}
